status: BENCHMARK - illustrative ranges from public sources; owner to confirm before publish
unit_basis: per square foot of finished wall area (both faces of form, concrete core, rebar, bracing, pour and stripping of bracing; excludes excavation, footings, waterproofing, backfill, interior finishes unless stated)

rows.label: Foundation and basement walls
rows.application: ICF foundation walls, 8 to 10 ft, 6 or 8 in core
rows.core_options: 6 in or 8 in concrete core; owner to confirm
rows.unit: per sq ft of wall installed
rows.basis: Three Ontario contractor/builder pages overlap on this band: ICFpro.ca basement wall $38-$48 and foundation wall $42-$55 (2026, Simcoe County/Georgian Bay), BuildersOntario.com wall assembly $42-$55 (2026), ICFhome.ca title $38-$48 installed (2026). US manufacturer figures ($22-$45 USD, Fox Blocks) are below this band and excluded. Low is the lowest Ontario basement figure; high is the highest Ontario foundation-wall figure.

rows.label: Full-height above-grade walls
rows.application: ICF main-floor and second-storey walls to 3 m floor-to-floor (Part 9 limit), 6 in core typical
rows.core_options: 6 in core typical above grade; 8 in where the wall below is 8 in (OBC 9.15.4.2.(2) makes the foundation core at least the core above); owner to confirm
rows.unit: per sq ft of wall installed
rows.basis: ICFpro.ca above-grade wall $42-$52 per sq ft (mid-point $47) with tall (10 ft+) or complex walls $45-$58; BuildersOntario.com generic wall assembly $42-$55. Low is the ICFpro above-grade floor; high is capped at the BuildersOntario ceiling, leaving the $58 tall-wall figure to the additions row. Owner to confirm whether above-grade pricing exceeds basement pricing on their jobs.

rows.label: Additions and garage walls
rows.application: ICF foundation or full-height walls for house additions and detached or attached garages; short perimeters, 8 to 9 ft walls
rows.core_options: 6 in core typical; 8 in where the engineer or the wall above requires it; owner to confirm
rows.unit: per sq ft of wall installed
rows.basis: LEAST-SUPPORTED ROW. No Ontario public source prices additions or garages separately. Range uses the ICFpro.ca above-grade floor ($42) and its tall/complex-wall ceiling ($58) because short perimeters carry the same mobilization, pump truck and bracing set-up as a full house. Owner to replace with their own figures before publish.

project_examples.label: Typical 1,200 sq ft bungalow foundation, 8 ft walls
project_examples.footprint_assumed: 40 ft x 30 ft rectangle = 1,200 sq ft; perimeter 2 x (40 + 30) = 140 ft
project_examples.wall_area_calc: 140 ft perimeter x 8 ft wall height = 1,120 sq ft of wall
project_examples.basis: 1,120 sq ft x foundation row $38-$55 per sq ft = $42,560-$61,600, wall system only (forms, rebar, bracing, concrete, pour, labour). Excavation, footings, waterproofing, weeping tile, slab, backfill and grading are extra; BuildersOntario.com puts typical site costs on top at $40K-$70K to reach a finished foundation.

project_examples.label: Worked example published by BuildersOntario.com: 160 ft perimeter, 8 ft walls
project_examples.footprint_assumed: 160 ft perimeter as given on the source page
project_examples.wall_area_calc: 160 ft x 8 ft = 1,280 sq ft of wall (source's own arithmetic)
project_examples.basis: Source states 1,280 x $42 = $53,760 and 1,280 x $55 = $70,400, wall only; excludes excavation, footings, waterproofing, drainage, slab, backfill. https://buildersontario.com/icf-foundation-cost-2/

poured_comparison_note: Illustrative only. ICFpro.ca (Ontario contractor, 2026) puts a bare poured concrete wall at $15-$25 per sq ft of wall, a poured wall plus the interior framing, insulation and vapour control needed to meet the 2024 OBC at $28-$38, and the resulting ICF premium at $7-$15 per sq ft of wall ($13,000-$28,000 on 1,840 sq ft of basement wall). BuildersOntario.com (2026) puts the typical ICF premium over a bare poured wall at $8K-$18K per house. Whole-house percentage premiums quoted publicly (3-7% ICFpro; 3-5% Concrete Alberta and BuildBlock (USD); 5-10% Carbondale Construction) describe finished houses versus wood frame, not wall-for-wall, and must not be presented as the wall premium. Fox Blocks (USD) lists poured basement walls at $15-$35 per sq ft against installed ICF basement walls at $22-$45; US figures are shown for context only and were not used in the CAD bands.
excluded_note: Typically outside the per-sq-ft wall figure: excavation and shoring; footings (formwork, rebar, concrete); dampproofing or waterproofing membrane and protection board; weeping tile, drainage layer and stone (required by OBC 9.13 and 9.14 and inspected before backfill); backfill and grading; window and door bucks and lintels beyond standard openings; structural engineering and the Toronto Assumption of Responsibility form where an engineer seals the drawings; permit fees; concrete pump truck; winter heating, hoarding and cold-weather admixtures (ICFpro cites a 20-30% concrete premium in shoulder seasons); brick ledge or taper-top forms; interior finishes and thermal-barrier drywall.
illustrative_note: Illustrative ranges only. Each site carries its own conditions: soil, water table, wall height, openings, access and season all move the number. The firm price is the written quote after a site review.
included_note: Owner to confirm what the per-sq-ft price includes.
